'''Thad Haren''' is an old warhand under the command of [[Gareth Bryne]] and brick maker in retirement.

== Appearance ==
His wrinkled face is like crumpled leather.

It is said that, despite being beyond seventy yeas of age, he could still "track yesterday's wind across stone by moonlight."

== Activities ==
He sets off with Gareth to track down [[Siuan Sanche]] when she broke her oath to Gareth. This leads him all the way from [[Andor]] to [[Salidar]] where the Rebel [[Aes Sedai]] are.{{ref/book|5|1}}

He is sent to scout around and find out what the [[Whitecloaks]] are doing.
